question: Who Owns Shake Shack?
quick_answer: Shake Shack is a publicly traded company listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker SHAK, so it is owned by its shareholders. It grew out of a hot dog cart started in 2001 by restaurateur Danny Meyer's Union Square Hospitality Group in New York City, became a permanent stand in 2004, and went public in 2015.

body.heading: Who owns Shake Shack?
body.text: Shake Shack is a public company, owned collectively by its shareholders. It trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker SHAK. While restaurateur Danny Meyer and his company are closely tied to Shake Shack's founding and remained influential, as a public company it is owned by its shareholders rather than one person.

body.heading: From a hot dog cart to a chain
body.text: Shake Shack began in 2001 as a hot dog cart in Madison Square Park in New York City, run by Danny Meyer's Union Square Hospitality Group. It proved so popular that it became a permanent kiosk in 2004 and then grew into a fast-casual burger chain known for its ShackBurger and shakes.

body.heading: Going public
body.text: Shake Shack held its initial public offering in 2015, turning it into a publicly traded company. Since then its ownership has been spread among public shareholders, while it continues to expand in the US and internationally.
